basic_details.job_title: OERC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Commission Secretary, Director of Tariff and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Commission Secretary, Director of Tariff, Director of Engineering and Director of Regulatory Affairs

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age: 57 years as on 1st October 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate degree / Post Graduate degree / MBA / CA / CMA / CFA / Degree in Law / Electrical Power Engineering
qualification.details: Commission Secretary: Graduate degree from a recognized university with 10 years judiciary or administrative experience, out of which 5 years at the management level. Director of Tariff: Post Graduate degree in Economics or Graduate degree in Electrical/Power Engineering with 15 years' experience as a professional economist or professional Engineering experience, of which at least five years include managing professional staff. Director of Engineering: Graduate degree in Electrical/Power Engineering with 15 years of engineering experience with at least five years at the management level in large power utilities. Director of Regulatory Affairs: Graduate degree in Electrical/Power Engineering, Degree in Law from recognized University/Law School, or MBA in Finance or equivalent or CA / CMA / CFA with 15 years professional experience in power utilities/Regulatory Commission/Central/State Government, out of which at least five years' experience in Regulatory Affairs.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.orierc.org.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OERC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.orierc.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OERC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the OERC recruitment 2026 is 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for various director-level and secretary positions under the Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates must send their duly filled application forms via post or email to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts mentioned in the notification is 57 years as of 1st October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these positions?
faq.answer: All selected candidates will be placed in Level-17, cell-1 of the 7th Pay Matrix, with an initial basic pay of Rs. 1,35,100 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official recruitment notification for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply via email?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can submit their applications via email at [email protected] or [email protected] on or before 16 October 2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts involves the shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted on a deputation basis, as specified in the official notification released by the Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: The hard copy should be sent to the Secretary, Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission (OERC), Plot No.4, Bidyut Niyamak Bhawan, OERC Road, Shailashree Vihar, Bhubaneswar - 751021, Odisha.
